7.4.2.24 Service 0x85 - ControlDTCSetting
An external test tool can request an ECU to either disable or enable DTC storage in the ECUs error memory by sending a UDS Service 0x85 request with sub-function 0x01 ("ON") or 0x02 ("OFF"). The ControlDTCSetting service in ISO 14229-1:2020 [9] allows the optional parameter DTCSettingControlOptionRecord. The diagnostic server instance always supports Manager this parameter. This effectively means that a ControlDTCSetting service with or without DTCSettingControlOptionRecord is processed in the same way. As defined in
[SWS_Dcm_01399] the DTCSettingControlOptionRecord is limited to the one and only 0xFFFFFF value.
[SWS_Dcm_00249] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04159
⌈The Dcm module shall implement UDS Service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) to enable or disable the storage of DTCs in the ECUs error memory.⌋
[SWS_Dcm_01399] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04159
⌈If the Dcm receives a ControlDTCSetting (0x85) service with DTCSettingControlOptionRecord != 0xFFFFFF, the Dcm shall send a NRC 0x31 (RequestOutOfRange).⌋
[SWS_Dcm_01063] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04115
⌈On reception of UDS Service 0x85 with subfunction 0x01 (DTCSettingType "ON"), the Dcm shall call Dem_EnableDTCSetting() with ClientId = Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef).⌋
[SWS_Dcm_00783]
⌈In case of Dem_EnableDTCSetting returns E_OK (see
[SWS_Dcm_01063]), the Dcm shall invoke a mode switch of the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype DcmControlDTCSetting by calling SchM_Switch_<bsnp>_DcmControlDTCSetting (RTE_MODE_DcmControlDTCSetting_ENABLEDTCSETTING).⌋
[SWS_Dcm_00406] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04115
⌈On reception of UDS Service 0x85 with subfunction 0x02 (DTCSettingType "OFF"), the Dcm shall call Dem_DisableDTCSetting() with ClientId = Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef).⌋
[SWS_Dcm_00784]
⌈In case of Dem_DisableDTCSetting returns E_OK (see
[SWS_Dcm_00406]
),
